roofline.note: single-thread. AVX2 = 2 FMA ports × 8-wide × 2 flop. SIMD128 = 4-wide mul+add, no FMA.

wasm_footprint.note: profile wasm is feature-gated and is NOT the shipped artifact. Default wasm:build must stay bit-identical to 49a6e8d2.

H1.predict: time proportional to tokens x weights if each token re-reads every weight block

H2.predict: attention / V-mix O(n²) scalar or re-allocate per token dominates
H2.scores_alloc: one Vec<n_tokens> per attention call, not per token (see ops.rs attention_named)

H3.predict: JS boundary copies / allocation per call dominate the WASM path

H4.predict: a hot path with no SIMD128 (opcode count is not coverage)

llama_single.method: sum of llama-embedding 'prompt eval time' with -t 1 (model already resident after first call; each spawn still reloads — use prompt-eval, not wall)
